mappedIdentity.name: Griffith Mansion
mappedIdentity.method: photo-correlated roof and approach visible in public-domain NAIP, model wall lines estimated from roof and ground photos

limitations: The June 2009 exterior omits interiors, detached buildings and private landscape features. The extent of obscured wall lines, rear windows and roof folds is approximate. Columns, brackets and sash ornament are simplified.
Federal orthophotography controls scale and position. The original terrain remains unchanged. Step and threshold contact is approximate.
